title: ListHotRangesResponse
description: Hot ranges across the cluster or filtered to a specific node.

ranges.description: Array of hot range objects sorted by activity level.

next.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of hot range results.

HotRange.description: A range identified as hot due to elevated query activity, including the range descriptor and per-second query throughput.

range_id.description: Unique identifier of the hot range.

node_id.description: Node ID of the node reporting this hot range.

qps.description: Queries per second observed on this range.

table_name.description: Name of the table this range belongs to, if known.

db_name.description: Name of the database this range belongs to, if known.

index_name.description: Name of the index this range belongs to, if known.

schema_name.description: Schema name for the table this range belongs to, if known.
